text: Two dogs are about to meet at the park. Will they get on? Nobody knows until they try.
In cocoverse, every pet has an AI twin, built only from moments that really happened. So the twins can meet first.
Coco's owner sends an invite, and picks what Coco's twin may share: play, walks, trips, other animals.
Biscuit's owner opens it, and the two twins talk. Each one only says what its own photos show.
It works the same on your phone.
Both owners get the same note. Worth a try. And every reason points back to a real card.
It also says what to watch for. Coco likes to rest with her toy. Biscuit wants to run. It's advice. You still decide in person.
cocoverse. A little universe for you and your pet.
